name: Compliance officer
description: Manages remediation (APQC 11.3): after a breach, failure or finding, investigates the cause, confers with experts and counsel, drafts the remediation plan and the policy change, and tracks the plan until it is closed.

onet.title: Compliance Officers
onet.basis: APQC 11.3 is remediation plans, investigating cause and legal aspects and amending policy, the examining, investigating and correcting of nonconformity with laws that O*NET describes for compliance officers; chosen over the --complete suggestions, which are environmental site roles.
onet.by: agent, EE-249 step 11 (not yet reviewed by a person)

questions: What caused the failure, and which obligation did it break?
What must change so it cannot happen again?
